items.title: Fake VS Code Security Alerts on GitHub Used to Push Malware in Widespread Phishing Campaign
items.description: A large-scale phishing campaign is targeting software developers on GitHub, using fake Visual Studio Code security alerts posted in GitHub Discussions to trick users into downloading malicious software. items.title: WebRTC Skimmer Bypasses CSP to Steal Payment Data from E-Commerce Sites
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have discovered a new payment skimmer that uses WebRTC data channels as a means to receive payloads and exfiltrate data, effectively bypassing security controls. items.description: A sophisticated evolution of Kerberoasting dubbed the “Ghost SPN” attack that allows adversaries to extract Active Directory credentials while erasing all traces of their activity, rendering traditional detection models effectively blind to the intrusion.
